name: clipsync-monorepo
description: Universal clipboard, synchronization and content sharing platform

scripts.build: tsc -b packages/shared-types packages/protocol-schema packages/storage services/relay packages/sync-engine packages/api-client services/api packages/cli
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b packages/shared-types packages/protocol-schema packages/storage services/relay packages/sync-engine packages/api-client services/api packages/cli && pnpm --filter @clipsync/web run typecheck
